about: What give-up-check.js looks for in the assistant's last message. Each entry is a regular expression, matched case-insensitively against one sentence at a time, with code and quoted output taken out first. givesUp and handsBack mark a sentence that stops early; notGivingUp cancels a match in the same sentence; asksFirst marks a question the assistant must ask before an irreversible step, which is a finished ending and always passes.
givesUp: \bI (?:can ?not|can't|cannot|couldn't|could not|wasn't able to|was not able to|am unable to|'m unable to|am not able to|'m not able to|was unable to)\b
\bI(?:'ll| will) (?:stop|leave it|leave this|leave that|leave the rest) here\b
handsBack: \b(?:do|finish|complete|run|fix|handle) (?:this|that|it|the rest|these|them)(?: \w+){0,4} (?:yourself|manually|by hand|on your own|on your side)\b
